author: gemini-antigravity
scope: Genuine coupled staggered PDAS re-equilibration execution on non-coarsened C6 mesh (15,252 CPE4 quads, 15,559 physical nodes) at target uy = 0.0018703125 mm using convex damage under-relaxation (omega_d = 0.5) with post-relaxation KKT stationarity evaluation, joint displacement consistency (<= 1e-9 mm), history consistency (<= 1e-4 MPa), and gated checkpoint serialization. Authorized for exactly 1 PBS submission; serial 1 CPU, 16 GB, 8 h.
scientific_hypothesis: Package 171-R1 exhibited nonconvergent alternating oscillations at Outer 100 (delta_d ~ 7.17e-3, delta_u ~ 4.51e-5 mm, delta_h ~ 271.5 MPa). Under the falsifiable numerical hypothesis omega_d = 0.5, convex damage relaxation dampens crack-tip strain-damage oscillatory feedback while strictly preserving d >= d0, d <= 1.0, post-relaxation KKT stationarity, coupled-field consistency (delta_u <= 1e-9 mm, delta_H <= 1e-4 MPa), and non-accumulating history.

mathematical_formulation.mesh_level: C6 (15,252 CPE4 elements, 15,559 physical nodes + RP 999999, 59 duplicate seam-slit pairs)
mathematical_formulation.kkt_evaluation: Explicit post-relaxation KKT stationarity recomputation: solver.kkt(d^{k+1}, tau_active=1e-6, tau_free=1e-6) evaluated under corresponding H^{k+1}
mathematical_formulation.coupled_field_consistency: Final mechanical subproblem resolution on converged damage state to ensure u, d, H, RF, and energies refer to a mutually equilibrated state with delta_u <= 1e-9 mm and delta_H <= 1e-4 MPa
mathematical_formulation.obstacle_enforcement: Pointwise active-set Dirichlet clamp prescribed = {n: d0[n] for n in active} ensuring min(d - d0) >= -1.0e-6

source_differences: Package 171-R4 remediates the remaining consistency review defect from HND-F1602-R3-REVIEW-FD31DC83: (1) Enforces final mechanical displacement consistency ||u_final - u_staggered||_inf <= 1e-9 mm directly within the physical_pass acceptance predicate; (2) Recomputes final driving history and enforces ||H_final - H_staggered||_inf <= 1e-4 MPa directly within physical_pass; (3) Evaluates final KKT stationarity on relaxed damage under final history H* (free, dual, comp <= 1e-6); (4) Suppresses checkpoint commitment if any consistency or physical gate fails; (5) Adds driver-level failure-path regression tests proving that excessive delta_u, excessive delta_H, and failed KKT independently prevent checkpoint serialization.
